summary: Tested NativeAd viewport-containment fix on Expo web at 390x844. Bottom game placements PASS on all 6 game screens (tic-tac-toe, memory-match, math-sprint, higher-lower, tap-rush, trivia-streak): ads visible, height 210-668px, no horizontal/vertical overflow. In-card placements PASS on /quizzes (quiz-native-ad-active 292x210 inside card), /surveys (intro ad 292x210 inside card), /watch-earn and /withdraw (342x210). CRITICAL FAILURE remains on /daily-challenge in the unclaimed '4 mystery boxes' state (the exact state in the user's error screenshot): dc-native-ad y=680 h=210, bottom=890 > vh=844, page is NOT scrollable (scrollHeight=844, scrollY stays 0), so the ad card is permanently clipped ~46px at the bottom. The fix only works in the claimed/loading state (ad expands h=464 into blank space, bottom=844 exactly). Device-login flow verified working (token issued, /auth/me 200); deep-linking to game screens without a session produces repeated 'Not authenticated' toasts and no redirect to /login. ESLint: 2 pre-existing react/no-unescaped-entities errors unrelated to the ad change.

ui_bugs.issue: NativeAd clipped at viewport bottom: ad bounds y=679.8 h=210 bottom=889.8 exceed vh=844 by ~46px; inner card bottom=873.8 also clipped. Screen is not scrollable (document scrollHeight=844=vh, wheel/scrollTo no-op), so the clipped area is unreachable. Root cause: SafeAreaView flex column with header+hero+boxGrid+empty legend (padding lg) consuming ~680px, leaving < minHeight(210) for the ad host; flexShrink cannot go below minHeight so it overflows. Needs: make the screen scrollable (ScrollView) or reduce/remove the empty legend spacer and let the ad shrink. Reference: frontend/app/daily-challenge.tsx:77-145, NativeAd.web.tsx:20-28 (host minHeight 210).

integration_issues.flow: Deep-link to authed game screens (/higher-lower, /quizzes, /surveys, /visit-earn) without an existing session
integration_issues.issue: Screens fire authed API calls before/without device login (deviceLogin only runs on /login screen, login.tsx:27). Result: repeated 'Not authenticated' error toasts, screens stuck on Loading or empty states, and their NativeAd placements never render. No redirect to /login. Only reproducible on fresh session deep-links; normal flow via login works.

issues: Empty state ('No sites available right now') renders no NativeAd at all - ad only exists inside the sites-list branch (visit-earn.tsx:237). Given the user's requirement that native ads stay visible everywhere, consider rendering the ad in the empty state too.
Empty state page is mostly blank (large unused vertical space).
Empty legend View (daily-challenge.tsx:128-129) wastes 48px of vertical space that contributes to the ad overflow in the boxes state.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /daily-challenge ad clipping in the unclaimed boxes state - wrap content in ScrollView (or reduce boxGrid/hero/legend heights) so dc-native-ad's minHeight 210 host never exceeds the viewport; remove the empty legend spacer. Verify at 390x844 that dc-native-ad bottom <= 844 with boxes visible.
Render NativeAd in /visit-earn empty state (no sites) so the placement is not invisible when there is no data.
Optional: add auth guard/redirect to /login when game screens load without a session token instead of repeated 'Not authenticated' toasts.
Minor ESLint: escape apostrophes (react/no-unescaped-entities) at math-sprint.tsx:187 and tap-rush.tsx:278 (pre-existing, unrelated to ad fix).
critical_code_review_comments: NativeAd host uses flexGrow+flexShrink with minHeight 210: expands into blank space correctly (verified h=464 on daily-challenge claimed state, h=668 on memory-match) but cannot shrink below 210 on space-constrained screens, causing the daily-challenge overflow.
Deep-link auth gap: deviceLogin is only invoked from login.tsx; other screens assume a token exists. Not caused by this iteration's change.
ESLint on the 9 changed files: only 2 pre-existing react/no-unescaped-entities errors; NativeAd.tsx, NativeAd.web.tsx and adWrap style changes are lint-clean.

No deprecated expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) detected in the reviewed components; no SafeAreaView-from-react-native misuse in changed files (uses react-native-safe-area-context).

success_rate.frontend: 11/12 ad placements pass; 1 CRITICAL fail (daily-challenge boxes state)

seed_data_creation: Two anonymous device users created via web device-login flow (TEST browser sessions); one earlier via curl device_id=TEST_iter36_webcheck. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To test authed screens on web you must first goto /login and click [data-testid=login-continue-btn] (device login); fresh Playwright contexts have no session and game screens will 401. Daily-challenge has two layouts: claimed/loading (ad passes, h=464) vs unclaimed 4-boxes (ad clipped, bottom=890>844). dc-native-ad inner card margins are fine (x=24,w=342). quiz-native-ad-after only renders post-quiz-completion; quiz-native-ad-active is the in-card placement during a question.
rca_of_issue: Bug: dc-native-ad clipped on /daily-challenge when mystery boxes render. Repro: 390x844 viewport, device-login, goto /daily-challenge with unclaimed state -> ad bottom=889.8 > vh=844, page not scrollable (scrollHeight=844). Cause: non-scrollable SafeAreaView flex column; fixed content (header+hero+2-row boxGrid+empty legend) leaves ~164px but ad host enforces minHeight 210 (flexShrink capped by minHeight). Mitigation: make the screen scrollable or reduce fixed content / lower ad minHeight on this screen. Note: main agent's smoke test only covered the low-content (claimed/loading) state where the ad correctly expands into blank space.
